sourceText.he: אָכַל טֶבֶל וּמַעֲשֵׂר וְכוּ׳: טֶבֶל פְּשִׁיטָא! לָא צְרִיכָא בְּטֶבֶל טָבוּל מִדְּרַבָּנַן. הֵיכִי דָּמֵי — בְּעָצִיץ שֶׁאֵינוֹ נָקוּב.

positions.claim: one who ate tevel or first tithe is not included in a zimmun
the tevel clause is needed for produce that is tevel only by rabbinic law, namely produce grown in an unperforated flowerpot
positions.basis: לא צריכא; עציץ שאינו נקוב is exempt from tithing by Torah law
